1tzg28u82we: Verify the entire chain even on a smartwatch. Nodes do not need to hold state, and in the end verifying a single proof is enough.

231fc2a6poc: Proposer-builder separation (PBS) and MEV countermeasures were still in the Splurge slot, "other improvements," at this point.

24e6r2ehink: The Scourge widened beyond MEV to cover liquid staking and the staking economy.

5irfd986vx: Surge was the path of growing rollups by increasing the number of shards, and Verge was the path of nodes not holding state via Verkle trees.
